name: PipelineChangelog
description: Derive the next semantic version from conventional commits, update CHANGELOG.md and version files, and open or update a release pull request
author: sethbacon
helpMarkDown: Parses conventional commits since the last release tag, computes the next version, prepends a release section to CHANGELOG.md, stamps version files, and opens or updates a release pull request. Authenticates as the pipeline's own identity via SystemVssConnection: the Build Service account needs **Contribute** and **Contribute to pull requests** on the target repository.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Repository root. Defaults to the agent's current directory.

inputs.name: changelogPath
inputs.label: Changelog path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the changelog, relative to the working directory. Created with a Keep a Changelog header if absent.

inputs.name: tagPrefix
inputs.label: Tag prefix
inputs.helpMarkDown: Prefix on release tags, e.g. `v` for `v1.2.3`.

inputs.name: targetBranch
inputs.label: Target branch
inputs.helpMarkDown: Branch the release pull request targets.

inputs.name: capZeroMajor
inputs.label: Keep pre-1.0 releases pre-1.0
inputs.helpMarkDown: When the current major is 0, a breaking change bumps the MINOR (0.3.7 to 0.4.0) instead of reaching 1.0.0. Matches release-please's `bump-minor-pre-major`. Turn off for strict semver.

inputs.name: versionFiles
inputs.label: Version files
inputs.helpMarkDown: One `path#$.json.path` per line, e.g. `azure-devops-extension.json#$.version`. A bare path defaults to `$.version`. Fails if a listed path does not resolve.

inputs.name: commitLimit
inputs.label: Commit limit
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum commits read from history. Bounds memory on a repository that has never been tagged.

inputs.name: openPullRequest
inputs.label: Open or update the release pull request
inputs.helpMarkDown: When off, the task updates files and sets its output variables without calling the Azure DevOps REST API.

inputs.name: accessToken
inputs.label: Access token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Overrides the job's own SystemVssConnection token. Only needed for cross-repository or cross-organisation publishing. Pass a secret variable, never a literal.

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.label: Dry run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Compute and print the release without writing any file or calling the REST API.

outputVariables.name: releaseRequired
outputVariables.description: `true` when the commits since the last tag justify a release.

outputVariables.name: previousVersion
outputVariables.description: The version the last release tag carried.

outputVariables.name: releasePullRequestId
outputVariables.description: The id of the release pull request that was created or updated.

messages.CommitsConsidered: Read %s commit(s), of which %s parsed as conventional commits, since %s.
messages.NothingToRelease: No releasable change since the last tag: every commit was a silent type or unparseable.
messages.VersionFileMissing: Version file %s does not exist; skipping it.
messages.VersionFileUnstampable: Version file %s has no value at %s, so the release would ship a manifest still claiming the previous version.
messages.DryRunSummary: Dry run: version %s, changelog %s, %s version file(s) would be stamped.
messages.DryRunComplete: Dry run complete for %s. No file was written and no pull request was opened.
messages.FilesUpdated: Updated the changelog and version files for %s.
messages.AccessTokenUnavailable: No access token is available. Enable 'Allow scripts to access the OAuth token' on the job, or supply the accessToken input.
messages.PipelineContextMissing: System.TeamFoundationCollectionUri, System.TeamProject and Build.Repository.ID must all be set; this task must run in an Azure Pipelines build.
messages.AdoResponseUnparseable: Azure DevOps returned a response for '%s' that is not JSON.
messages.ReleasePrReady: Release pull request for %s is ready: !%s
